decision.rationale: Fresh exact-SHA replay is byte-identical; independent raw recount and event accounting conserve every active row across compact write and both tile replays, retain all 6,762,595 popcount1 fallback rows, preserve all-row matcher cost, satisfy DMA/address/slot/service bounds and reproduce 543,784,143 baseline versus 503,016,392 candidate cycles. No P0/P1 blocks a bounded VCS controller implementation, but row payload, retirement/write timing and FIFO occupancy remain RTL obligations.

findings.title: Row-ID preservation is specified but not payload-traced
findings.detail: Twelve row-ID bits cover 0..2999 and active counts/bytes are conserved, but M377 emits phase-level byte events rather than 48-bit descriptor values. The VCS controller must prove row ID, original pattern, center ID, residual/use_pwp and flags are written and replayed in order.

findings.title: One-write-per-cycle is a feasible inherited retirement contract, not a row trace
findings.detail: Every matcher event lasts 3044..4991 cycles for 3000 rows and active writes never exceed event duration. M377 nevertheless does not timestamp individual SERIAL16 retirements or compact write-pointer updates; simultaneous retire/write, stalls and bank handoff require VCS assertions.

findings.title: FIFO occupancy remains rate-proved rather than explicitly simulated
findings.detail: Every active replay event satisfies one startup cycle plus at least four service cycles per descriptor, so a one-bundle-per-cycle producer cannot cause post-start underflow. Depth-8 full/backpressure and exact enqueue/dequeue occupancy are still controller-level obligations.

findings.title: No frozen runtime partition exercises the empty-stream branch
findings.detail: The minimum active population is 89 and empty_partitions=0. A directed synthetic invocation confirms M377 retains pattern DMA, all-row matching, tail and commit while suppressing tile DMA/replay, but VCS must cover reset/stall and empty bank reuse around this branch.

findings.title: The admitted gain is module- and cohort-scoped
findings.detail: 1.0810466x covers a timestamped q32/O4 module schedule for four bottleneck Conv inputs on frozen PAFT S10. It excludes q32 matcher/descriptor SRAM area, RTL cycle match, power, dynamic BN/ATLIF/attention/FC integration, system Amdahl and broader sequence generalization.

vcs_controller_required_gates: Bit-exact compact descriptor payload including row12 and signed residual/use_pwp fields
One compact write at each nonzero matcher retirement, no write for original16==0, and no popcount1 fallback loss
Write-pointer, read-pointer, bank epoch and order preservation under randomized ready/valid stalls
Depth-8 FIFO full/backpressure, post-start no-underflow and two tile replay conservation
Directed empty partition, all-active partition, reset during fill/drain, bank alternation and protocol attack coverage
Cycle count match against a small frozen event trace before any DC integration
